subject: website
name: The Trustless Manifesto
summary: The Trustless Manifesto site, a small static blog, open source in marissaposner/trustlessness.eth (no licence file). Its home page loads only its own files. It stays at Level 2 because the manifesto page imports the ethers library from cdn.jsdelivr.net with no integrity hash, code the CDN can change at any time.

connections.name: ethers from cdn.jsdelivr.net
connections.note: Imported as code when the manifesto page opens; the pledge button then works through the visitor's wallet.
